Report internals

Source: R/test-report.R
report_internals.Rd

check_report() stops when report is not one; add_section() adds a section that is drawn when the report is saved, so the header can come in any order; html_*() draw the parts. For internal use only.

Usage

prepare_series(tests, dates)

check_report(report)

add_section(report, part, draw)

html_page(report)

html_header(report)

html_method(zones, boundary)

html_lede(r)

html_stats(r)

html_figure(zones)

html_plot(plot, caption, height = 3.5)

html_progress(r, cv)

html_reference(r)

html_zones(zones, sport)

html_prediction(r)

html_checks(x)

html_stages(info)

html_methods(x, info)

Arguments

tests

A list of results of lactate_threshold().

dates

Their dates, or days since the first test.

report, r

A report from report_start().

part

The name of the section, for printing.

draw

A function of the report that returns the section's HTML.

zones

The result of lactate_zones().

boundary

1 for LT1, 2 for LT2.

plot

A ggplot or a patchwork, drawn without its title and subtitle.

caption

The text under it.

height

Its height, in inches; it is 7 inches wide.

sport

The sport.

x

The result of lactate_threshold().

info

The lactater attribute of the results.
